name: phase2_contention_refusals
description: Phase 2 cutover: one count per refusal with a contention code (…-busy, estimate-build-superseded) written by a Phase 2 financial callable. Counts only; extracts nothing from the log entry. Read by phase2-contention-repeated.policy.json.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name=("createvariation" OR "updatevariationdraft" OR "approvevariation" OR "applyvariationcommitment" OR "progressclaimoperation" OR "supplierinvoiceoperation" OR "suppliersettlementoperation" OR "postclientrefund" OR "voidclientrefund" OR "postclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientinvoice" OR "contractvalueoperation" OR "estimateoperation" OR "postclientcreditnote" OR "voidclientcreditnote" OR "postclientretentionrelease" OR "voidclientretentionrelease" OR "postclientreceipt" OR "voidclientreceipt" OR "transferboqtobudget" OR "approvefinalaccount") AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stdout") AND jsonPayload.message=("variation call refused" OR "supplier-finance call refused" OR "client finance call refused" OR "contract-value call refused" OR "estimate call refused" OR "boq transfer call refused" OR "final account call refused") AND jsonPayload.code=("boq-transfer-busy" OR "client-finance-busy" OR "estimate-build-superseded" OR "estimate-busy" OR "final-account-busy" OR "supplier-finance-busy" OR "variation-busy")
